write_up: Your resume points first to Mathematics Teacher roles, with digital learning design emerging from your classroom work. A recruiter can see what you teach and how your Canvas module connects to it, though the department leadership work needs more detail.

The line about teaching five sections of 28 to 32 students is a strong model: it names the subjects and gives a recruiter a clear picture of your classroom. Your in-progress certificate and Storyline workshop also show where you're building your design skills.

Let's start with the Canvas module and the math department's professional learning community. A little more about what you built and led will give both teaching and learning design recruiters more to work with.
